summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 user-reported bug fixes (validation feedback, add-traveler icons, hint removal, mobile card click) and key regressions. All bugs verified as FIXED.

BUG 1: Invalid fields have data-invalid='true' attribute (3 fields detected)
BUG 1: Page auto-scrolls to first invalid field and focuses it
BUG 1: After filling contact fields, wizard advances to step 2
BUG 1: Step 2 validation shows specific field names with traveler prefix (e.g., '1. yolcu: Vize türü, Gidiş tarihi, Dönüş tarihi')
BUG 1: Step 3 validation shows traveler prefix for missing files (e.g., '1. yolcu: Pasaport fotoğrafı, 1. yolcu: Vesikalık fotoğraf')
BUG 2: 'Yetişkin ekle' button shows Plus + User icons (2 icons)
BUG 2: 'Çocuk ekle' button shows Plus + Baby icons (2 icons)
BUG 3: AI passport label row shows only 'Pasaport kimlik sayfası' with NO 'JPG veya PNG' text
BUG 3: Dropzone itself still shows 'JPG / PNG / PDF · Maks. 10 MB' format hint (correct)
BUG 4: Mobile (390x844) card click navigates to /basvuru?vize=... on home page
BUG 4: Desktop (1920x900) card click still works correctly
BUG 4: Keyboard Enter on card navigates correctly
BUG 4: Card click works on /vize-tipleri page
BUG 4: Specific scenario - Çok Girişli tab → visa_60_multi card click navigates to /basvuru?vize=visa_60_multi
BUG 4: Overlay link (data-testid visa-card-overlay-{id}) covers card body correctly (z-[1])
BUG 4: Popular ribbon has z-[2] to stay above overlay
REGRESSION: AI passport OCR autofill works (uploads passport, triggers AI processing, fills traveler fields)
REGRESSION: Multi-traveler add works (second traveler card appears)
REGRESSION: Admin login works (admin@vizeatlas.com / Dubai2026!)
REGRESSION: Step-by-step wizard navigation works (step 1 → step 2 → step 3)
REGRESSION: Pricing tabs work (4 tabs: Tek Girişli, Çok Girişli, Çocuk Vizesi, Diğer Hizmetler)
